title: Game Rules
content:
# Happy Farmer

## Overview

You run a farm in the countryside. Each day you plant, water and harvest, turn crops into more valuable goods, then sell them through merchants, consignment, auctions and the second-hand market.

The core loop is simple: **plant → harvest → process → sell → unlock more**. No stamina limits, no forced quests, no daily check-ins.

---

## 1. Basic flow

1. **Till** – tap an empty plot, play the tilling mini-game (3 turns)
2. **Plant** – tap a tilled plot and pick a seed **you actually have in storage**
3. **Water** – watering boosts that day's growth
4. **Harvest** – tap a mature plot to collect into storage
5. **Sell** – merchants, consignment, auction, or quick sell
6. **Level up** – harvesting and bonuses grant EXP, unlocking more crops and features

> After harvesting, the plot returns to **untilled** and must be tilled again.

---

## 2. Farm management

### 2.1 Land

- You start with 6 plots, 4 of them already tilled
- Each new plot costs **+25%** more than the previous one
- No upper limit on plots; the UI shows 60 per page with pagination

### 2.2 Bulk actions

| Button | Effect | Unlock |
|---|---|---|
| Water all | Waters every crop (costs gold) | From the start |
| Harvest all | Harvests every mature crop | From the start |
| Till all | Play the mini-game **once** to till every empty plot | **Level ≥ 16 and plots ≥ 21** |
| Fertilize all | Apply one fertilizer to every planted plot | From the start |

### 2.3 Growth

- **Weather**: sunny/cloudy ×1.0, light rain ×1.2, heavy rain ×1.4, storm ×0.8
- **Season**: spring ×1.1, summer ×1.0, autumn ×1.0, winter ×0.8
- **Watering**: +50% that day (+100% with the golden watering can)
- **Fertilizer**: extra bonus depending on type
- **Greenhouse**: removes bad-weather penalties
- **Second-hand seeds**: growth ×0.75 and they get sick more often

### 2.4 Storage and seeds

- Storage capacity can be upgraded; you cannot harvest when full
- Seeds take storage space just like other items
- Second-hand seeds are separate items with a "（二手）" suffix

---

## 3. Factory

- **1893** processed goods across 9 levels
- Processing needs materials + gold + time (in days)
- Level-1 goods use **crops**; level 2+ use lower-tier processed goods
- Collect finished goods in the "Completed" tab
- The processing accelerator halves processing time

---

## 4. Trading

### 4.1 Seed store

The right-hand seed store sells seeds by category, showing only crops unlocked at your level.

### 4.2 Merchant Hub

Open **Merchant Hub** (bottom right):

- Shows how many days until the next merchant arrives
- Lists all **5 merchants** with their buying rules
- **Call merchant** instantly for **days until next visit × 200 gold**
- When a merchant is in town that card is highlighted — tap **Trade now**

The trade dialog shows the merchant on the left and the **sell center** on the right.

### 4.3 Quick sell

Sell instantly for **40%–60% of market value** (rolled each time you open it).

### 4.4 Consignment

List items at your own price. Lower price sells faster; unsold items return after 7 days. A listing fee applies.

### 4.5 Auction

- You may start your own auction **once every 14 days**
- **NPCs also host auctions** you can bid on (you get a notification)
- **You cannot bid on your own auction**, to prevent price manipulation
- Bidding runs for 3 days, highest bid wins

### 4.6 Second-hand market

Mall → **Other → Open second-hand market**:

- Daily stock of **second-hand seeds** and **fertilizer** at about **45%** price
- Trade-off: seeds grow slower and get sick more often; fertilizer has half effect
- Stock refreshes each day

---

## 5. Mall

Five tabs: **Basic / Normal / Mid / High / Other**.

### 5.1 Items

100 items: gold packs, EXP books, permanent boosts (EXP/gold/luck/storage/discount/merchant), timed boosts (double EXP, double gold, scarecrow, greenhouse, irrigation, factory boost, harvest blessing, event shield) and automation (auto water/harvest/plant).

**Every item works exactly as described.**

### 5.2 Other

- **Support goods**: buy fertilizer directly
- **Limited seeds**: high-tier seeds available to buy **even below the required level** (3× price)
- **Second-hand market** entry

---

## 6. Weather, seasons and events

- Weather changes daily; seasons rotate over time
- Random events may fire each day:
  - **Good**: treasure, lucky day, rain blessing, sunshine, early merchant, free item, mall discount
  - **Bad**: theft, crop disease
- **Scarecrow** or **event shield** blocks theft
- Higher **luck** makes good events more likely
- The **Fortune board** scores weighted good events only (bad events never subtract)

---

## 7. Quests and achievements

- **Daily quests**: 3 per day (plant/harvest/water/till/process/trade) for gold
- **Achievements**: 150 total, including hidden ones

---

## 8. Gold

**There is only one currency: gold 💰.** Farming, processing, trading and the mall all settle in gold.

---

## 9. Leaderboard

### 9.1 Joining

The leaderboard unlocks at **level 5**. The first time you open it, you choose your visibility.

### 9.2 Ten boards

| Board | Metric |
|---|---|
| Gold | Current gold |
| Level | Current level |
| Days | Days played |
| Achievements | Achievements unlocked |
| **Speed** | Total EXP from level 1 ÷ days |
| **Fortune** | Weighted score of good events |
| Collection | Crop types collected |
| Factory | Processed goods types made |
| Wealth rate | Gold ÷ days |
| Overall | Sum of 1/rank across boards |

### 9.3 Visibility

- **Public** — nickname and avatar are shown (requires agreeing to the privacy policy)
- **Anonymous** — hide nickname, hide avatar, or both

> **Custom uploaded avatars are never uploaded to the leaderboard.** Only built-in emoji avatars and avatar-library images are supported.

### 9.4 When it updates

- **Automatically on every level up**
- You may also refresh manually, but only **once every 5 in-game days**

### 9.5 Data

The leaderboard stores up to **100,000** players and only the fields needed for ranking. Your full save always stays on your own device.

---

## 10. Settings and saves

- **Auto-save** to browser localStorage; manual save available anytime
- **Export / import** saves as a `.lelelefarmer` file
- **Back to title** button (does not delete progress)
- **Language switch** between 中文 / English, resuming automatically

---

## 11. Shortcuts

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| Space / Enter | Next day (when off cooldown) |
| Esc | Close dialog / collapse drawer |
| S | Save now |

---

## 12. Notice

Produced by **LelelelingStudio · Lelelegame**. Rules may change with updates; the in-game behaviour is authoritative.
